deviations.what: The picked day IS transportable after all - measured 2026-08-05 with `scripts/probes/event-arg-expression-probe.mjs` against real OpenUI5: an event arg is a full UI5 expression, and indexed access into an array-valued getter plus chained calls resolve there (`$event.oSource.getSelectedDates()[0].getStartDate()`). The earlier rationale - 'select carries no date parameter and the selected DateRange is control state' - was wrong. The wire carries the three LOCAL date parts as three expression args (year, month+1, day) rather than `toISOString( )`, which would shift the day for any user east of Greenwich, and each arg is guarded by `getSelectedDates().length > 0` so a re-click that clears the selection arrives as year 0. App 177 now formats the SELECTED day as yyyy-MM-dd, and the original's else-branch is reproduced exactly: re-clicking the same day removes it from the selection, the guard reports year 0 and the Text falls back to 'No Date Selected'. Residual: 'Select Today' writes the text (server date = today) without moving the calendar's highlight. **Reworked 2026-08-23.** Two behaviours of handleCalendarSelect / handleSelectToday were missing and the sidecar claimed the opposite. (a) The original keeps the last picked day and REMOVES the DateRange when the same day is clicked again; single-selection mode never deselects by itself (Month._selectDay only ever re-points or adds a range - the removal in the multi-selection branch is unreachable here), so the guard that was said to 'reproduce the else-branch exactly' could never fire and the re-click just re-wrote the same date. The port now compares the picked day against the one it holds and clears both the text and the selection. (b) handleSelectToday is removeAllSelectedDates + addSelectedDate(today); the port wrote the text only, so the calendar kept highlighting the previously clicked day while the label said today. Both are model writes now: selectedDates is bound as a DateRange aggregation over an ABAP table, the shape app 139 uses for the same control family, with the startDate going through Formatter.DateAbapDateToDateObject (local midnight, not UTC).

The CAL_SELECT / SELECT_TODAY round-trips updating the bound selectedDate Text are unverified in a running system. **e2e-verified 2026-07-30** (transpiled-framework interaction, scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs): 'Select Today' round-trips and the bound #selectedDate Text shows the yyyy-MM-dd value; CAL_SELECT is NOT exercised by that module - it clicks the button only, so the three $event.oSource.getSelectedDates() expression args, the risky part of this port, are unasserted (and since the 2026-08-23 rework the deselect branch and the bound aggregation are unasserted too).

The sample's own stylesheet is injected since 2026-08-21 through an added core:HTML style leaf (no counterpart in the original view). This sample's manifest lists `../style.css` - the sheet the sap.ui.unified samples SHARE one folder up - and it was never archived, so the viewPadding / labelMarginLeft classes the view carries had no rule behind them and the port rendered flush against the page edge where the sample renders padded. The sheet now sits at ui5/sap.ui.unified/style.css (closing the AGENTS section 4 archive gap) Injected are the rules that reach this view: the two viewPadding rules, labelMarginLeft, and - since 2026-08-23 - .sap-phone .sapUiCal{position:relative}, which the first pass dropped as not used by the view. It is: sapUiCal is written by CalendarRenderer on the control's own root, not by the author. The sheet's remaining rule targets .sapUiCancel, which no renderer writes. Found by scripts/probes/orphan-style-class-probe.mjs.
